description: After Record-Breaking Rains, Texas Medical Center's Planning Improved Resilience is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Texas Medical Center; FEMA, Federal Emergency Management Agency.
